description: Formatting whitespace variants that cannot change step boundaries or schedule.

candidate_sets.pattern: boundary between two reasoning paragraphs already separated by at least one newline
candidate_sets.note: Varies blank-line presence at an EXISTING boundary only. Never merges lines (that would be merge/split — protected, channel 2) and never inserts a break inside a paragraph.

exclusions: any whitespace inside or adjacent to code blocks
indentation of any kind (list hierarchy is protected)
whitespace inside symbolic expressions (belongs to rule 06)
markdown constructs where blank lines change rendering semantics of lists/tables

registered_predictions.fable_depth_interaction: zero on base/light-instruct; lowest-priority rule for post-RL emergence (low entropy)
